Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000235": Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000221": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000219" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000209": Marcus has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-02-12, after Lena handed the pager to him.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000204": Tomasz is off the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-02-12.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000201": Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000101": Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000075": Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000043": The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego, ledger service, notifier, push provider, Lena, Marcus, Atlas team, Tomasz, Priya Raman, the bus, INC-2025-004, Farah, Dune team, feature-flags
